description: This file defines an abstract base class for 'text' configurable field types in Drupal, including methods for default settings, form handling, dependency calculation, property definitions, default value application, emptiness check, change handling, and sample value generation.

classes.name: TextItemBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for 'text' field types, providing core functionality for handling text formats, settings, property definitions, and sample data generation.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings, including allowed formats.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for allowed text formats.

methods.name: validateAllowedFormats
methods.description: Validates and processes the allowed formats selected in the form.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies based on allowed formats.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines data properties: value, format, and processed text.

methods.name: applyDefaultValue
methods.description: Applies default value to the field, placeholder for default format.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field value is empty.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles changes to properties, especially format and text source.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates sample data for testing or default content.
